It has the highest level of world knowledge, advanced text and language capabilities, higher consistency, and more precise creative control.'
At launch (June 30, 2026) Nano Banana 2 Lite was 'rolling out today in Google consumer surfaces' including the Gemini app.
Workspace users who have had access to Nano Banana Pro will keep access to Nano Banana Pro for specialized tasks by regenerating images via the three-dot menu.
'Redo images with Nano Banana Pro' is not available without a Google AI plan; it is available on AI Plus, AI Pro and AI Ultra (feature-availability table).

Product page: 'To access Nano Banana, select "🍌Create images" from the tools menu. You can use the ”Fast,” “Thinking,” or “Pro” model from the model menu. Then add a prompt or upload an image to edit.' The page does not map these menu items to image models.

Extractor's summary of the Gemini Apps Help page: the image model is picked indirectly through the Gemini model selector — Flash-Lite → Nano Banana 2 Lite, Flash or Pro → Nano Banana 2; Nano Banana Pro is reached only by 'Redo with Pro' on an existing image and needs a paid Google AI plan.

приёмы.текст_en: To use Nano Banana Pro for a specialized task in the Gemini app, generate the image first (Nano Banana 2 by default in every mode), then regenerate it with Pro from the three-dot menu ('Redo with Pro').

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The task says 'generate it in the Gemini app' or 'redo it in Pro', mentions the Fast/Thinking/Pro modes or a plan (free, Plus, Pro, Ultra), or compares 'Gemini came out differently than the API' — you need to know which image model actually runs behind the button.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: A call through the Gemini API / AI Studio / Agent Platform with an explicit model ID — the call sets the model, not the app switch; other products (Slides, NotebookLM, Flow) have their own rules.

словарь_терминов.значение_en: Nickname and brand of the Gemini image models: on 2025 pages it means Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, in 2026 it is the name of the whole family (Pro, 2, 2 Lite); the NB2 page says 'Nano Banana' without a number. Variants across pages: 'fondly known as Nano Banana' (2025); 'Nano Banana (Gemini 2.5 Image)' (E-142-1); 'Nano Banana (aka Gemini 2.5 Flash Image)' (E-232-1); 'Nano Banana from Gemini 2.5 Flash' (page 330); 'the Gemini image model' (E-188-2); 'the latest image editing model' (E-280-1, 2025); 'our latest Nano Banana model' / 'the latest Nano Banana model' (2026, version not named — E-184-4, E-203-2, E-208-44); the codelab uses it for the family (E-90-16); android.com calls it a 'model', a 'tool' or a 'feature' (E-276-1, -2).

Regenerating a finished image with Nano Banana Pro via the three-dot menu ('More > Redo with Pro'); a paid option (Google AI Plus, Pro, Ultra). Variants: help: 'More > Redo with Pro'; blog: 'three-dot menu'; 'Redo images with Nano Banana Pro' (table E-247-18); 'regenerating images via the three-dot menu' (E-240-18).

Gemini model modes in the Gemini app menu; the chosen mode determines which Nano Banana draws. Variants: before Feb 26, 2026 Thinking = NB Pro (November 2025); after that NB2 everywhere, Flash-Lite = NB2 Lite, Pro mode + Redo = NB Pro; the NB2 page does not map the modes to image models (E-213-13).

The Gemini app tool for generating images ('🍌 Create images' in the tools menu). Variants: '🍌 Create images' in Tools (codelab) versus 'Open Sidebar > Images' (help) — different UI paths at different times.

A Gemini app feature that connects the user's context (Google apps, past chats) to generation; for images — tastes and real photos from Google Photos, mixed into NB2 generation. Variants: model: 'the latest Nano Banana model' (E-208-44) / 'Nano Banana' (E-328-3).

The Slides side panel for images, infographics and slides from a prompt (a Gemini feature in Google Slides on NB Pro). Variants: the Dec 2025 post names only an 'upgraded model'; model: NB Pro (November 2025) / not named (March 2026).
A one-click redesign of an existing slide that keeps its text (Gemini feature in Google Slides on NB Pro). Variants: part 1 says NB Pro directly for Beautify this slide.

A separate Google tool for generating and editing images in Workspace (Drive, Docs, Slides) on the 'latest Nano Banana model'; with access to it, Edit image in Docs opens Pics. Variants: pages 110/134 do not name the model.
NotebookLM video overviews with narration based on the sources; Nano Banana adds 6 styles and illustrations; two formats — Explainer and Brief (a short format).
A Google Lens mode (yellow banana icon) for editing a captured or selected photo.

словарь_терминов.значение_en: Google Photos AI editing features: Help me edit — the entry to AI editing in the Photos editor, editing and restyling by describing the change in words (U.S., Android, E-207-9); Create with AI — a section of ready-made templates on Nano Banana (18+); Ask — a button to start a conversation about a photo; Remix — turning photos into artistic styles. Remix in Photos is not the same as Remix in Google Messages (E-248-9).
The Outputs setting in Agent Studio (Agent Platform console): to generate Gemini images, select Image and text in the Outputs panel.

словарь_терминов.значение_en: Building apps from a prompt in Google AI Studio and the Gemini app: Playground — the AI Studio sandbox for experimenting with models; build mode / Build tab — creating an app from a single prompt; Build agent; Canvas in the Gemini app. Variants: 'build mode' (E-341-11) / 'Build tab' (E-356-8).

Google's AI creative studio (filmmaking tool) for images and videos: Refine (edits in words), an agent for multi-step tasks, custom tools, Text/Image to image modes; NB2 is used there for zero credits.
